text:
anna: Working on GH Actions wiring for evals PR gating. Want: only run heavy evals if model files or eval-metadata changed. Anyone done path filters + matrix with self-hosted runners?
raj: I prototyped something using paths: ['models/**','evals/**'] + workflow_dispatch. But matrix still spins up for other jobs.
sasha: You can use a conditional job: if: contains( github.event.head_commit.message, '[eval]' ) — but that's brittle.
mike: We should compute CHANGED_MODELS via a script in job step. set-output deprecated, use echo "CHANGED_MODELS=$vars" >> $GITHUB_ENV
anna: Example snippet I tried:
```bash
run: |
  CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep ^models/ || true)
  echo "CHANGED_MODELS=$CHANGED" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```
But matrix still creates runners.
lucy: For matrix you can use dynamic 'include' via outputs? hmm tricky.
raj: Idea: have a lightweight 'pr-check' job on GHA that sets a repo_dispatch to trigger 'long-evals' workflow only if CHANGED_MODELS non-empty. That avoids matrix spawn.
anna: Nice. Any tips for self-hosted runners? We have limited eval runners and they get flooded with CI that doesn't need GPU.
sasha: Tag runners with labels: 'eval-gpu' vs 'cpu-small'. Use runs-on: [self-hosted, eval-gpu] for heavy jobs.
ci-bot: Scheduled nightly: evals-nightly @ 03:00 UTC queued on pool 'eval-gpu'. id=nightly-20260320-03
mike: Also add concurrency/grouping to avoid overlapping nightly + PR burst: concurrency: evals-${{ github.ref }}
anna: Edge case: quant experiments sometimes need older model weights; we should pin artifacts or S3 refs in the workflow to avoid cache mismatch.
lucy: For logs/metrics, export METRICS_URL env and post back a small JSON with run_id to the eval-dashboard service.
raj: We had flakiness where GH Actions times out after 6h; Buildkite pipeline handles long jobs better. Maybe move long-running evals to Buildkite and call it from GHA dispatch.
sasha: We could make GHA PR gate run smoke evals (fast) and dispatch full evals to Buildkite nightly or on-demand.
anna: Plan: 1) add lightweight pr-check job to detect changed models; 2) if changed, repo_dispatch -> long-evals workflow targeting Buildkite; 3) tag and queue runners. I'll send a draft PR.
mike: :thumbsup: small ask — add test case for path detection to evals-ci unit tests.
lucy: I'll wire the dashboard hook to accept run metadata. Ping me when PR up.
deploy-bot: CI workflow updated on main branch: .github/workflows/evals-pr-check.yml
anna: Thanks all. I'll post the PR link when ready. @sasha @mike please review the self-hosted runner docs I updated.
